# Jien Luv 2 Bake

> A small-batch home bakery in Sungai Ara, Penang, Malaysia. Focaccia is baked to order
> on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays, and can be collected in Sungai Ara or delivered
> around Penang.

⚠️ WHAT THIS FILE IS, PLAINLY: `llms.txt` is a proposed convention (a short, factual summary
for AI assistants), not a standard that Google, OpenAI or Anthropic have committed to. Some
tools read it; most do not yet. It costs one small file and it states only facts that already
appear on the website — no claim is made here that the site does not make itself.

## What is for sale now

- **Focaccia**, 12" × 9" — **RM16**. Soft on the inside, golden on the outside. Pre-order only.

The Italian Pesto Ham, Croissant, Mushroom & Egg and Vegetarian Pie are listed on the site as
**coming soon** and are not available to order.

## How ordering works

- **Bake days:** Monday, Wednesday and Friday.
- **Orders close at 6:00PM the day before the bake day.**
- **Collect** in Sungai Ara, or **delivery** around Penang.
- Order online at https://jienluv2bake.com.my/store/
